decisions.rationale: Existing trusted direction is Tauri parent to child stdin; packaged proof is required before choosing bootstrap v2.
identity_namespace_hash is stable but OS-user ownership validation is not proven.
Use T0/F1/T1/T2/F2 and keep product aggregate atomic.
Exact-identical sources converge; divergent sources fail closed under frozen binding-set CAS.
One compatibility generation needs three-DB backup and whole-set restore.
Freeze TC-GS-01..09, pinned fixture and exact commands before implementation.

required_spikes.question: Can native Documents resolution cross the existing trusted parent-child bootstrap before Python composition in the current packaged macOS build?
required_spikes.fallback: Stop and request architecture approval if a new entitlement or backend-to-host RPC is required.

required_spikes.question: Can identity_namespace_hash plus OS-owned file invariants form a profile-generation-stable and OS-user-isolated global owner key?
required_spikes.fallback: Stop and request a different trusted owner identity design if current identity storage cannot prove isolation.
